I read this as adding a failing-first frontend regression test for closing an active browser tab via the native `menu_close_tab` bridge - will run the single-test filter to demonstrate the missing test before addition, add the test in `ui/src/App.test.tsx`, and verify green execution.

### Pre-addition Run (Test Missing)
```
$ vitest run --maxWorkers=1 App -t "routes the native Cmd+W menu accelerator to close an active browser tab"
 RUN  v3.2.7 /Users/indo/code/project/orca-lite/ui
 Test Files  3 skipped (3)
      Tests  50 skipped (50)
```

### Changes Made
- `ui/src/App.test.tsx`: Added unit test `routes the native Cmd+W menu accelerator to close an active browser tab` verifying that when the active tab in `workspaceStore` layout is a `kind: "browser"` tab with a `browserId`, triggering the native menu callback registered via `onCloseTabMenu` invokes `workspace.closeTab` with the active browser tab's ID, restoring fixture layout state in a `try/finally` block.

### Verification
Ran `bun run --cwd ui test -- App --reporter=verbose`:
```
 ✓ src/App.test.tsx > App project workspace flow > routes the native Cmd+W menu accelerator to close an active browser tab 4ms
 Test Files  3 passed (3)
      Tests  51 passed (51)
```
